purpose: Academic prediction of recorded Normal/Anormal label; not clinical validation
groups: split_group candidate equivalence, not confirmed patient identity
sensitivity_development_only: log1p when selected estimator is logistic

temporal_secondary.status: hypothetical chronology; secondary robustness evaluation, no independent external validation

bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on fitted model and candidate groups; not full training or selection uncertainty

prior_exploration: The full source was explored in A1. This holdout is reserved for modeling from this protocol, not untouched by prior exploration.
clinical_derivatives: No unverified percentiles or diagnostic reclassification; historical PPA only where scenario permits.
test_policy: Freeze selected candidates for every scenario before first access to heldout metrics. No test-driven changes.
